caption:
Figure 1. Overview of PanoVGGT and the PanoCity dataset. PanoVGGT predicts camera poses, dense depth, and consistent 3D point
clouds from unordered panoramas. Compared with perspective-based pipelines that split panoramas into pinhole views, it yields more
accurate 3D reconstructions. PanoCity contains over 120k outdoor panoramas under diverse urban scenes and weather conditions.
delegated_acceptance_review: Actually viewed final PanoVGGT/PanoCity figure, read caption and source introduction on dataset annotations, and reviewed all pair checks. Original panorama stack, twelve split views, two reconstruction results, all six weather scenes, camera/weather icons and crossing vertical titles remain complete. Added top groups separate method versus dataset roles; bottom pose/depth/point-cloud predictions and dataset pose/depth supervision are explicitly source-supported. Full scientific source image is preserved; no new weather or geometric result is added.
